about: [O1] The walk-through (brief O1 §7, WAVE_C §7 5, GAME_TWO §1 C): on foot by real keys (W held, each walk set up facing its target) into what is solid in every district - a facade, an el column, a kerb (stepped up), a dead end's wall, a street door (E: it rattles, locked), the quay's railing, the rail yard's gate (open) and its fence, a gas holder, a garden's wall, the park's railing and its gate (open), the clock tower, the bridge's barrier, my own car - each stops the eye short (never inside a box) or lets it through where it is open. tools/lib/o1_city.mjs 'walk'. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1_walk.json

walks.name: el column
walks.from: (() => { const c = G.stage.part('el').columns.filter((c) => Math.abs(c.x + 116.1) < 0.6 && c.z > 0 && c.z < 60)[0]; window.__col = c; return [c.x + 5, c.z]; })()

walks.name: tenements street door
walks.from: (() => { const S = G.stage.part('stream'); S.warmAround(240, -25); const d = S.doorNear(240, -25, 25); window.__door = d; return [d.x + d.nx * 3, d.z + d.nz * 3]; })()

steps.label: the walk-through: every wall, pillar, kerb, door, rail and fence answers
